integrity: Analytic proof with a standalone exact-rational finite-state checker; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns finite-size first-parent activation histories and their triangular-array limit with n/a_n converging. It does not determine the entire tree or cover time. Finite tests support but do not prove the infinite assertion. Potential latent implication from related rare-innovation results is an unresolved priority risk.
title: Marked Poisson activation law in the strong-reinforcement window for preferential-attachment trees
